it: La Torre Rovente è nelle mani di una coppia di sposi. Stando a chi li ha sfidati prima di te, la moglie, Quruiza dall'occhio finto, è di livello 24, e il marito, Corgon il drago d'acciaio, di livello 16.

jp: クルイツゥアは逃げ回りながら冷気や暗黒の魔法を撃ってくるって話。そう、灼熱の塔を攻略するには、火炎だけじゃなくて冷気と暗黒にもある程度耐性が必要ってこと。
jp_grezzo: "クルイツゥアは逃げ回りながら冷気や暗黒の魔法を撃ってくるって話" + _da(3) + "。そう、灼熱の塔を攻略するには、火炎だけじゃなくて冷気と暗黒にもある程度耐性が必要ってこと" + _dana(3) + "。"
en: I've heard that Quruiza casts cold and darkness magic while darting around. So in order to conquer the Tower of Fire, you need to have some resistance to cold and darkness as well as fire.
en_grezzo: "I've heard that Quruiza casts cold and darkness magic while darting around. So in order to conquer the Tower of Fire, you need to have some resistance to cold and darkness as well as fire."
it: Pare che Quruiza scappi in giro tirando magie di gelo e oscurità. Ecco: per venire a capo della Torre Rovente non basta la resistenza al fuoco, ci vuole anche un po' di resistenza al gelo e all'oscurità.

jp: コルゴンは竜なので妻よりずっとタフだけど、近づいて殴ってくるだけで動きも遅いらしい。テレポートでコルゴンを翻弄しつつ、先にクルイツゥアを集中攻撃したほうがいいんじゃない？
jp_grezzo: "コルゴンは竜なので妻よりずっとタフだけど、近づいて殴ってくるだけで動きも遅いらしい。テレポートでコルゴンを翻弄しつつ、先にクルイツゥアを集中攻撃したほうがいいんじゃない" + _kana(3) + "？"
en: Corgon is a dragon, so he's much tougher than his wife, but I've heard that he just moves in to hit you, and his movements are pretty slow. I think it's better to focus your attacks on Corgon first while using teleportation to keep Quruiza at bay.
en_grezzo: "Corgon is a dragon, so he's much tougher than his wife, but I've heard that he just moves in to hit you, and his movements are pretty slow. I think it's better to focus your attacks on Corgon first while using teleportation to keep Quruiza at bay."
it: Corgon è un drago, quindi è molto più duro della moglie, ma a quanto pare si limita ad avvicinarsi e a menare, e si muove piano. Meglio tenere Corgon a bada col teletrasporto e concentrare prima gli attacchi su Quruiza, no?

jp: 接近戦がやりづらいだろうから、強力な遠距離攻撃があるとスムーズかもしれない。あの灼熱の塔に住めるだけあって、どちらも火炎には滅法強いらしいけど、コルゴンのほうは電撃と魔法にも強いそう。
jp_grezzo: "接近戦がやりづらいだろうから、強力な遠距離攻撃があるとスムーズかもしれない" + _na(3) + "。あの灼熱の塔に住めるだけあって、どちらも火炎には滅法強いらしいけど、コルゴンのほうは電撃と魔法にも強いそう" + _da(3) + "。"
en: Close-quarters combat with those two would prove difficult, so a powerful long-distance attack might help you smooth things out. I've heard that the couple is extremely resistant to fire, given that they live in, you know, the Tower of Fire, but I've also heard that Corgon is resistant to electric and magic attacks as well.
en_grezzo: "Close-quarters combat with those two would prove difficult, so a powerful long-distance attack might help you smooth things out. I've heard that the couple is extremely resistant to fire, given that they live in, you know, the Tower of Fire, but I've also heard that Corgon is resistant to electric and magic attacks as well."
it: Il corpo a corpo sarà difficile, quindi con un attacco a distanza potente le cose filano più lisce. Vivono nella Torre Rovente, quindi al fuoco resistono tutti e due in modo esagerato; ma Corgon regge bene anche il fulmine e la magia.

jp: 情報によると古城の主『ワイナン』はレベル25。強力な地獄武器を持っているけど、基本は逃げ回りながら冷気や暗黒の魔法を撃ってくる。挑むなら地獄、冷気、暗黒の耐性が少しはあったほうがいい。
jp_grezzo: "情報によると古城の主『ワイナン』はレベル25。強力な地獄武器を持っているけど、基本は逃げ回りながら冷気や暗黒の魔法を撃ってくる。挑むなら地獄、冷気、暗黒の耐性が少しはあったほうがいい" + _na(3) + "。"
en: According to my information, <Wynan> the lord of the Ancient Castle is level 25, and although he has a powerful hell element weapon, he mainly flies around and casts cold and dark magic. If you want to challenge him, you'd better have some resistance to hell, cold, and dark magic.
en_grezzo: "According to my information, <Wynan> the lord of the Ancient Castle is level 25, and although he has a powerful hell element weapon, he mainly flies around and casts cold and dark magic. If you want to challenge him, you'd better have some resistance to hell, cold, and dark magic."
it: Stando alle mie informazioni, Wynan, il signore del Castello Antico, è di livello 25. Ha un'arma potente d'oltretomba, ma per lo più scappa in giro tirando magie di gelo e oscurità. Se vuoi sfidarlo, meglio avere un po' di resistenza a oltretomba, gelo e oscurità.

jp: 本人の守りは弱く、地獄にしか耐性がないらしいけど、取り巻きのチェスの駒が邪魔をしてくる。<キング>を処理しないと、次々に敵を呼ばれてジリ貧になるって話。
jp_grezzo: "本人の守りは弱く、地獄にしか耐性がないらしいけど、取り巻きのチェスの駒が邪魔をしてくる。<キング>を処理しないと、次々に敵を呼ばれてジリ貧になるって話" + _da(3) + "。"
en: It seems that his own defense is weak and he only carries resistance to hell magic, but his chess piece cronies will block your path. If you don't deal with the <King> quickly enough, he'll summon more and more backup, and you'll eventually run out of luck.
en_grezzo: "It seems that his own defense is weak and he only carries resistance to hell magic, but his chess piece cronies will block your path. If you don't deal with the <King> quickly enough, he'll summon more and more backup, and you'll eventually run out of luck."
it: Lui in sé si difende male, e pare che resista solo all'oltretomba; ma i pezzi degli scacchi che si porta dietro ti tagliano la strada. Se non fai fuori il <Re>, continua a chiamare nemici e finisci per consumarti.

jp: 変化の杖や突然変異のポーションで別のモンスターに変えれば、1ターンで済む。通らない場合は集中攻撃で急いで<キング>を倒すこと。
jp_grezzo: "変化の杖や突然変異のポーションで別のモンスターに変えれば、1ターンで済む。通らない場合は集中攻撃で急いで<キング>を倒すこと" + _dana(3) + "。"
en: If you can use a rod of change creature or a potion of mutation to change him into another monster, you can finish him off in a single turn. If that won't work, make sure that you waste no time in focusing your attacks on the <King>.
en_grezzo: "If you can use a rod of change creature or a potion of mutation to change him into another monster, you can finish him off in a single turn. If that won't work, make sure that you waste no time in focusing your attacks on the <King>."
it: Se lo trasformi in un altro mostro con una bacchetta di mutamento di creatura o una pozione di mutazione, basta un turno. Se non passa, allora fuori il <Re> in fretta, concentrando gli attacchi.

jp: 死者の洞窟に行くの？命知らず。逃げ帰ってきた奴の話では、闇の奇形『イスシズル』はレベル28。
jp_grezzo: "死者の洞窟に行くの" + _ka(3) + "？命知らず" + _dana(3) + "。逃げ帰ってきた奴の話では、闇の奇形『イスシズル』はレベル28。"
en: You're pretty daring to think of taking on the Crypt of the Dead. According to the last adventurer that went in and escaped with his life, <Issizzle> the dark abomination is level 28.
en_grezzo: "You're pretty daring to think of taking on the Crypt of the Dead. According to the last adventurer that went in and escaped with his life, <Issizzle> the dark abomination is level 28."
it: Vai alla grotta dei morti? Che sprezzo del pericolo. Stando a uno che è tornato scappando, Issizzle l'aberrazione oscura è di livello 28.

jp: テレポートしつつ冷気や暗黒の魔法を放ってきたらしい。装備の力で魔法が増幅されているらしく、とんでもない威力だと言っていた。冷気と暗黒の耐性をそれなりに高めていかないと瞬殺されるかもしれない。耐性が足りない場合は属性耐性のポーションも試してみて。
jp_grezzo: "テレポートしつつ冷気や暗黒の魔法を放ってきたらしい。装備の力で魔法が増幅されているらしく、とんでもない威力だと言っていた" + _na(3) + "。冷気と暗黒の耐性をそれなりに高めていかないと瞬殺されるかもしれない。耐性が足りない場合は属性耐性のポーションも試してみて" + _kure(3) + "。"
en: It seemed that he teleported around while casting cold and dark magic. Apparently, the magic he casts is amplified by the power of his equipment, and the guy said it's incredibly powerful. If you don't have enough resistance to cold and darkness, you might be instantly killed. If you don't have enough resistance, try drinking some potions of resistance.
en_grezzo: "It seemed that he teleported around while casting cold and dark magic. Apparently, the magic he casts is amplified by the power of his equipment, and the guy said it's incredibly powerful. If you don't have enough resistance to cold and darkness, you might be instantly killed. If you don't have enough resistance, try drinking some potions of resistance."
it: Pare che si teletrasporti in continuazione tirando magie di gelo e oscurità. La magia gli viene amplificata dall'equipaggiamento, e diceva che la potenza è fuori misura. Se non alzi bene la resistenza al gelo e all'oscurità rischi di morire sul colpo. Se non basta, prova anche con le pozioni di resistenza.

jp: 挑戦者は暗黒、地獄、神経属性で反撃したがほとんど効いてなかったとも言っていた。もし、神や不死者に威力を発揮する武器があれば活躍するんだろうけど、無い物ねだりをしても仕方がない。
jp_grezzo: "挑戦者は暗黒、地獄、神経属性で反撃したがほとんど効いてなかったとも言っていた" + _yo(3) + "。もし、神や不死者に威力を発揮する武器があれば活躍するんだろうけど、無い物ねだりをしても仕方がない" + _na(3) + "。"
en: The brave soul also said he fought back with the darkness, hell, and nerve attributes, but they hardly made a scratch. If you have a weapon that's powerful against gods and immortals that would certainly come in handy, but I guess there's no point in begging for what you don't have.
en_grezzo: "The brave soul also said he fought back with the darkness, hell, and nerve attributes, but they hardly made a scratch. If you have a weapon that's powerful against gods and immortals that would certainly come in handy, but I guess there's no point in begging for what you don't have."
it: Lo sfidante diceva anche di aver risposto con oscurità, oltretomba e nervi, e che non gli facevano quasi niente. Se avessi un'arma che picchia forte sugli dèi e sui non morti sarebbe un'altra storia, ma inutile chiedere quel che non c'è.

jp: 噂だとザナンの暗殺部隊がレシマスを侵攻しているらしい。奴らはレベル25だけど、気配消しと光学迷彩で姿が見えない、不可視の部隊。
jp_grezzo: "噂だとザナンの暗殺部隊がレシマスを侵攻しているらしい。奴らはレベル25だけど、気配消しと光学迷彩で姿が見えない、不可視の部隊" + _da(3) + "。"
en: Rumor has it that a Xanan assassination squad is invading Lesimas. They're level 25, but they also use stealth and optical camouflage to hide themselves, so they'll be invisible to the naked eye.
en_grezzo: "Rumor has it that a Xanan assassination squad is invading Lesimas. They're level 25, but they also use stealth and optical camouflage to hide themselves, so they'll be invisible to the naked eye."
it: Gira voce che una squadra di assassini di Zanan stia invadendo Lesimas. Sono di livello 25, ma cancellano la propria presenza e si mimetizzano otticamente: una squadra invisibile.

jp: レシマスを進めば確実に襲われる。特殊な歩法で一瞬で接近してくるから、距離をとって戦うのも難しいはず。
jp_grezzo: "レシマスを進めば確実に襲われる" + _daro(3) + "。特殊な歩法で一瞬で接近してくるから、距離をとって戦うのも難しいはず。"
en: If you delve further into Lesimas, you're bound to run into them eventually. Since they're specially trained not to give away their presence as they approach, it's going to be tough to fight them from a distance.
en_grezzo: "If you delve further into Lesimas, you're bound to run into them eventually. Since they're specially trained not to give away their presence as they approach, it's going to be tough to fight them from a distance."
it: Se scendi in Lesimas ti assaltano di sicuro. Si avvicinano in un attimo con un passo speciale, quindi tenerli a distanza sarà difficile.

jp: 恐ろしい連中だけど、物質感知の魔法や巻物で位置はわかるし、水魔法やポーションをぶつけて濡らせば透明状態を解除できる。もし透明なものを視られるようになる装備があれば最高。
jp_grezzo: "恐ろしい連中だけど、物質感知の魔法や巻物で位置はわかるし、水魔法やポーションをぶつけて濡らせば透明状態を解除できる" + _yo(3) + "。もし透明なものを視られるようになる装備があれば最高" + _dana(3) + "。"
en: They're a fearsome bunch, but you can figure out where they are by casting Sense Object, and you can counter their invisibility by hitting them with water magic and potions to get them wet. If you could get your hands on some equipment that lets you see invisible objects, that would be the best option.
en_grezzo: "They're a fearsome bunch, but you can figure out where they are by casting Sense Object, and you can counter their invisibility by hitting them with water magic and potions to get them wet. If you could get your hands on some equipment that lets you see invisible objects, that would be the best option."
it: Sono gente da paura, ma con la magia o la pergamena di Percezione oggetti si capisce dove sono, e se li bagni con la magia dell'acqua o con una pozione l'invisibilità salta. Se hai un equipaggiamento che fa vedere le cose invisibili, meglio di così non si può.

jp: 暗殺部隊は複数のチームに分かれて行動しているらしいから、ひとつ撃破しても気を抜いてはいけない。…それと、部隊の中に白い面をつけた女がいたら用心。ここだけの話、ザナン皇家に拾われたイカれた殺人鬼が混ざっているらしい。
jp_grezzo: "暗殺部隊は複数のチームに分かれて行動しているらしいから、ひとつ撃破しても気を抜いてはいけない" + _yo(3) + "。…それと、部隊の中に白い面をつけた女がいたら用心" + _siro(3) + "。ここだけの話、ザナン皇家に拾われたイカれた殺人鬼が混ざっているらしい。"
en: I heard that the assassination squad is divided into several different teams, so don't let your guard down even after you manage to wipe one of them out. ...Also, if you see a woman wearing a white mask among the troops, be careful. Between you and me, it seems that there's some kind of homicidal maniac in the group who was scouted by the Zanan imperial family.
en_grezzo: "I heard that the assassination squad is divided into several different teams, so don't let your guard down even after you manage to wipe one of them out. ...Also, if you see a woman wearing a white mask among the troops, be careful. Between you and me, it seems that there's some kind of homicidal maniac in the group who was scouted by the Zanan imperial family."
it: Pare che la squadra si divida in più gruppi, quindi anche dopo averne battuto uno non abbassare la guardia. ...E poi: se fra loro c'è una donna con una maschera bianca, sta' in guardia. Qui fra noi: pare che ci sia in mezzo un'assassina fuori di testa, raccolta dalla casa imperiale di Zanan.

jp: 白面の『アルサピア』はレベル35。透明能力はないけど、踊るように通常攻撃を回避し、強烈なカウンターで標的を仕留めると言われている。ウワサ通りなら、矢や弾丸にすらカウンターしてくるとんでもない女。
jp_grezzo: "白面の『アルサピア』はレベル35。透明能力はないけど、踊るように通常攻撃を回避し、強烈なカウンターで標的を仕留めると言われている。ウワサ通りなら、矢や弾丸にすらカウンターしてくるとんでもない女" + _da(3) + "。"
en: <Alsapia> the murderer mask is level 35. She doesn't have invisibility, but she is said to evade normal attacks as if she were dancing, and to finish off her targets with powerful counters. If the rumors are true, she's one hell of a femme fatale, who's so strong that she can counter arrows and bullets.
en_grezzo: "<Alsapia> the murderer mask is level 35. She doesn't have invisibility, but she is said to evade normal attacks as if she were dancing, and to finish off her targets with powerful counters. If the rumors are true, she's one hell of a femme fatale, who's so strong that she can counter arrows and bullets."
it: Alsapia la maschera bianca è di livello 35. Non è invisibile, ma dicono che schivi gli attacchi normali come se ballasse, e che chiuda la partita con contraccolpi tremendi. Se le voci sono vere contrattacca perfino alle frecce e ai proiettili: una donna spaventosa.

jp: もし戦うことになったら魔法や技能などの回避不能攻撃で攻めるといい。状態異常の「束縛」で通常攻撃を回避できないようにするのも手ではある。
jp_grezzo: "もし戦うことになったら魔法や技能などの回避不能攻撃で攻めるといい。状態異常の「束縛」で通常攻撃を回避できないようにするのも手ではある。"
en: If you have to fight her, you should attack her with unavoidable techniques such as magic and skills. You could also apply the \"binding\" status effect on her so she can't dodge your normal attacks.
en_grezzo: "If you have to fight her, you should attack her with unavoidable techniques such as magic and skills. You could also apply the \"binding\" status effect on her so she can't dodge your normal attacks."
it: Se ti tocca combatterla, attaccala con quel che non si può schivare: magie e abilità. Un'altra via è metterle addosso lo stato di \"costrizione\", così gli attacchi normali non li schiva più.

jp: 束縛できないなら、通常攻撃する仲間には防御を指示しておくべき。防御の指示？コマンドフラッグで一括でやるか、技能の戦術指示で個別にやればいい？ああ、そうそう。暗殺部隊はアルサピア含め特に属性耐性は持っていないみたい。
jp_grezzo: "束縛できないなら、通常攻撃する仲間には防御を指示しておくべき" + _da(3) + "。防御の指示？コマンドフラッグで一括でやるか、技能の戦術指示で個別にやればいい" + _daro(3) + "？ああ、そうそう。暗殺部隊はアルサピア含め特に属性耐性は持っていないみたい" + _da(3) + "。"
en: If you're unable to bind her somehow, you should instruct your melee attacking companions to defend themselves. How to instruct them to defend? Why not use a command flag to give orders to everyone at once, or send orders to your companions individually by using the Directive skill? Ah, one more thing. Apparently, the entire assassination squad - including Alsapia - doesn't have resistance to any elemental damage in particular.
en_grezzo: "If you're unable to bind her somehow, you should instruct your melee attacking companions to defend themselves. How to instruct them to defend? Why not use a command flag to give orders to everyone at once, or send orders to your companions individually by using the Directive skill? Ah, one more thing. Apparently, the entire assassination squad - including Alsapia - doesn't have resistance to any elemental damage in particular."
it: Se non riesci a costringerla, ai compagni che attaccano di forza conviene ordinare la difesa. Come si ordina? Con la bandiera di comando tutti insieme, oppure uno per uno con l'abilità Ordini tattici. Ah, giusto: la squadra di assassini, Alsapia compresa, non pare avere resistenze di elemento particolari.

jp: 少し怖い話をしてあげ。
jp_grezzo: "少し怖い話をしてあげ" + _ru(3) + "。"
en: I'm going to tell you a story that's a little scary.
en_grezzo: "I'm going to tell you a story that's a little scary."
it: Ti racconto una storia un po' spaventosa.

jp: レシマスには、古代より多くの調査隊が向かっては命を散らしている。そう、出るん。調査兵のアンデッドが。
jp_grezzo: "レシマスには、古代より多くの調査隊が向かっては命を散らしている。そう、出るん" + _da(3) + "。調査兵のアンデッドが。"
en: Since ancient times, Lesimas has seen its fair share of expedition groups, and has claimed the lives of many. And what do you think happens to their dead bodies? Right - they rise from the grave.
en_grezzo: "Since ancient times, Lesimas has seen its fair share of expedition groups, and has claimed the lives of many. And what do you think happens to their dead bodies? Right - they rise from the grave."
it: A Lesimas, fin dall'antichità, sono andate molte spedizioni, e ci hanno lasciato la vita. Ecco: escono. I non morti delle squadre di esplorazione.

jp: 奴らは死んだことに気づかず今も調査を続けている。邪魔をした者は、身体を麻痺させられ地獄の吐息で嬲り殺しにされるん。抵抗しようともがいても、霧の中の幻には攻撃が届かない…。
jp_grezzo: "奴らは死んだことに気づかず今も調査を続けている。邪魔をした者は、身体を麻痺させられ地獄の吐息で嬲り殺しにされるん" + _da(3) + "。抵抗しようともがいても、霧の中の幻には攻撃が届かない…。"
en: The poor lads aren't even aware that they've passed on, and continue their investigations like everything's just dandy. Anyone who gets in their way will face a horrific end as they're paralyzed and tortured to death by the breath of hell. No matter how much you struggle or resist, your attacks won't reach the phantoms in the mist...
en_grezzo: "The poor lads aren't even aware that they've passed on, and continue their investigations like everything's just dandy. Anyone who gets in their way will face a horrific end as they're paralyzed and tortured to death by the breath of hell. No matter how much you struggle or resist, your attacks won't reach the phantoms in the mist..."
it: Non si sono accorti di essere morti e continuano a esplorare ancora oggi. Chi li ostacola si ritrova il corpo paralizzato, e muore torturato dal soffio d'oltretomba. E per quanto ti dibatta, agli spettri dentro la nebbia gli attacchi non arrivano...

jp: …麻痺を無効化する装備か守護石の魔法、宝石絢爛のポーションがあれば予防できるんじゃない？もちろん、神経や地獄の耐性が低いとダメージに耐えきれない可能性は。
jp_grezzo: "…麻痺を無効化する装備か守護石の魔法、宝石絢爛のポーションがあれば予防できるんじゃない" + _ka(3) + "？もちろん、神経や地獄の耐性が低いとダメージに耐えきれない可能性は" + _aru(3) + "。"
en: ...If you have equipment that nullifies paralysis, or know the Gem Power spell, or perhaps have a potion of gem on hand, you should be able to prevent yourself from meeting such a fateful end. Of course, if your resistance to nerve and hell damage is low, there's a chance you won't be able to withstand the damage.
en_grezzo: "...If you have equipment that nullifies paralysis, or know the Gem Power spell, or perhaps have a potion of gem on hand, you should be able to prevent yourself from meeting such a fateful end. Of course, if your resistance to nerve and hell damage is low, there's a chance you won't be able to withstand the damage."
it: ...Con un equipaggiamento che annulla la paralisi, o con la magia Pietra protettrice, o con una pozione di gemma, si può prevenire, no? Certo, se hai basse le resistenze ai nervi e all'oltretomba, il danno potresti non reggerlo.

jp: アンデッドということは火に弱いから、強力な火炎属性攻撃があるなら楽勝だと思う。逆に暗黒、地獄、神経属性は効かない。物理攻撃が当たりにくくなる霧を出すらしいけど、火炎瓶や蜘蛛の巣で霧は散らせる。
jp_grezzo: "アンデッドということは火に弱いから、強力な火炎属性攻撃があるなら楽勝だと思う" + _yo(3) + "。逆に暗黒、地獄、神経属性は効かない" + _daro(3) + "。物理攻撃が当たりにくくなる霧を出すらしいけど、火炎瓶や蜘蛛の巣で霧は散らせる" + _yo(3) + "。"
en: Being a plodding mass of rotting limbs means that you're vulnerable to fire, so if you have a powerful flame attribute attack, you'll win easily. On the other hand, the dark, hell, and nerve attributes won't do much. I've heard that those undead produce some kind of mist that makes it harder for physical attacks to hit them, but you can disperse the fog with molotov cocktails or spider webs.
en_grezzo: "Being a plodding mass of rotting limbs means that you're vulnerable to fire, so if you have a powerful flame attribute attack, you'll win easily. On the other hand, the dark, hell, and nerve attributes won't do much. I've heard that those undead produce some kind of mist that makes it harder for physical attacks to hit them, but you can disperse the fog with molotov cocktails or spider webs."
it: Essendo non morti, il fuoco li fa soffrire: con un attacco potente d'elemento fuoco secondo me è vinta facile. Al contrario oscurità, oltretomba e nervi non fanno niente. Pare che tirino fuori una nebbia che fa mancare i colpi fisici, ma la nebbia si disperde con le molotov o con le ragnatele.

jp: ゼームはパルミアでも高名な魔術士だった。彼の研究のひとつに、心を持った魔力仕掛けのガーディアンがあった。名前は確か…魔鋼の番兵『ギルフェム』。
jp_grezzo: "ゼームはパルミアでも高名な魔術士だった。彼の研究のひとつに、心を持った魔力仕掛けのガーディアンがあった。名前は確か…魔鋼の番兵『ギルフェム』。"
en: Zeome was a highly respected sorcerer in Palmia. One of his studies was related to a magical device guardian with a mind of its own. I believe its name was... <Gilphem> the magic steel.
en_grezzo: "Zeome was a highly respected sorcerer in Palmia. One of his studies was related to a magical device guardian with a mind of its own. I believe its name was... <Gilphem> the magic steel."
it: Zeome era un mago famoso perfino a Palmia. Una delle sue ricerche era un guardiano a congegno magico dotato di mente. Il nome, se non sbaglio, era... Gilphem, la sentinella d'acciaio magico.

jp: 王家にいた頃はどうしても完成させることができず悩んでいたそう。そんな彼が《常闇の眼》の膨大な情報を得たら？当然ギルフェムを完成させているはず。
jp_grezzo: "王家にいた頃はどうしても完成させることができず悩んでいたそう" + _da(3) + "。そんな彼が《常闇の眼》の膨大な情報を得たら？当然ギルフェムを完成させているはず。"
en: Back when Zeome was still a part of the royal family, he was troubled by the fact that he just couldn't seem to finish his research. So what would happen if such a troubled soul got hold of the vast amount of information held within the <Origin of Vice>? Naturally, he would have been able to bring Gilphem into the world.
en_grezzo: "Back when Zeome was still a part of the royal family, he was troubled by the fact that he just couldn't seem to finish his research. So what would happen if such a troubled soul got hold of the vast amount of information held within the <Origin of Vice>? Naturally, he would have been able to bring Gilphem into the world."
it: Ai tempi in cui stava con la casa reale non riusciva a portarlo a termine, e ci si tormentava. E se uno così mettesse le mani sulla massa di informazioni dell'<occhio delle tenebre eterne>? Ovvio: Gilphem l'ha finito.

jp: 研究段階でも魔法対策を施されていて、魔法属性の魔法…特に魔法の矢なんか全然効かなかったらしい。他の属性魔法なら多少は効くかもしれない。
jp_grezzo: "研究段階でも魔法対策を施されていて、魔法属性の魔法…特に魔法の矢なんか全然効かなかったらしい" + _na(3) + "。他の属性魔法なら多少は効くかもしれない。"
en: I've heard that, even though it's basically a research prototype, it was given special countermeasures against magic, and anything with a magic attribute... especially Magic Dart... it didn't do a thing. Perhaps if it's magic of another attribute, it might have a little effect.
en_grezzo: "I've heard that, even though it's basically a research prototype, it was given special countermeasures against magic, and anything with a magic attribute... especially Magic Dart... it didn't do a thing. Perhaps if it's magic of another attribute, it might have a little effect."
it: Già in fase di ricerca gli avevano messo le contromisure contro la magia, e le magie d'elemento magia... il Dardo magico soprattutto... non facevano proprio niente. Con magie di altro elemento forse qualcosa si ottiene.

jp: 文献では鎧をベースにした設計だったから、通常攻撃もあまり効かない。技能ならそのまま通ると思いたい。
jp_grezzo: "文献では鎧をベースにした設計だったから、通常攻撃もあまり効かない" + _daro(3) + "。技能ならそのまま通ると思いたい" + _na(3) + "。"
en: As far as what I can understand from reading the literature, its design used armor as a base, so normal attacks wouldn't work that well. My guess would be that using skills would allow you to pierce its shell.
en_grezzo: "As far as what I can understand from reading the literature, its design used armor as a base, so normal attacks wouldn't work that well. My guess would be that using skills would allow you to pierce its shell."
it: Nei documenti il progetto partiva da un'armatura, quindi anche gli attacchi normali servono a poco. Con le abilità c'è da sperare che passino.

jp: 防御重視のようだけど、弱った際に自分で安全装置を外して暴れ出したという記録もあった。もし暴れ出しても驚いて逃げたりせず、一気に押し切って破壊してしまうべき。
jp_grezzo: "防御重視のようだけど、弱った際に自分で安全装置を外して暴れ出したという記録もあった" + _yo(3) + "。もし暴れ出しても驚いて逃げたりせず、一気に押し切って破壊してしまうべき" + _da(3) + "。"
en: It seems to be defense-oriented, but I've also read reports of it detaching its own safeguards and going berserk out when it gets weak. If it does, don't be surprised and run away, just push it through and destroy it.
en_grezzo: "It seems to be defense-oriented, but I've also read reports of it detaching its own safeguards and going berserk out when it gets weak. If it does, don't be surprised and run away, just push it through and destroy it."
it: Sembra fatto per difendersi, ma c'è anche un rapporto che dice che, quando si è indebolito, si è tolto da solo i dispositivi di sicurezza e si è scatenato. Se si scatena non scappare per lo spavento: spingi fino in fondo e distruggilo.

jp: 偽りの預言者『ゼーム』はもはや怪物だと思った方がいい。レシマスに魅入られる前から、モンスターを召喚し混沌の渦を操り、深手も一瞬で治す魔術士だった。それが間違いなくレシマスの魔力で強化されている。
jp_grezzo: "偽りの預言者『ゼーム』はもはや怪物だと思った方がいい。レシマスに魅入られる前から、モンスターを召喚し混沌の渦を操り、深手も一瞬で治す魔術士だった。それが間違いなくレシマスの魔力で強化されている。"
en: You should consider <Zeome> the false prophet to have already lost all traces of humanity. Even before he became mesmerized by the power of Lesimas, he was a sorcerer who could summon monsters, manipulate the vortex of Chaos, and heal even the deepest wounds in the blink of an eye. It's no question that all of his abilities only been further enhanced by Lesimas' latent magical power.
en_grezzo: "You should consider <Zeome> the false prophet to have already lost all traces of humanity. Even before he became mesmerized by the power of Lesimas, he was a sorcerer who could summon monsters, manipulate the vortex of Chaos, and heal even the deepest wounds in the blink of an eye. It's no question that all of his abilities only been further enhanced by Lesimas' latent magical power."
it: Zeome il falso profeta conviene ormai considerarlo un mostro. Già prima di farsi ammaliare da Lesimas era un mago capace di evocare mostri, di governare il vortice caotico e di rimarginarsi in un attimo anche le ferite profonde. E adesso il potere magico di Lesimas l'ha senz'altro rinforzato.

jp: ゼームの前の守護者はレベル55だったらしいから、今のゼームもそのくらいあるんじゃない。さらにレシマスの宝物庫で、空を飛び魔法を増幅する大鎌を手に入れたという記録もある。混沌耐性がないと、どんなに人数を揃えても一瞬で壊滅してしまう。
jp_grezzo: "ゼームの前の守護者はレベル55だったらしいから、今のゼームもそのくらいあるんじゃない" + _kana(3) + "。さらにレシマスの宝物庫で、空を飛び魔法を増幅する大鎌を手に入れたという記録もある。混沌耐性がないと、どんなに人数を揃えても一瞬で壊滅してしまう" + _daro(3) + "。"
en: I've heard that Zeome's previous guardian was about level 55, so my guess is that Zeome is also around that level. There's also been reports of him wielding a scythe that allows him to fly and amplifies his magic in the treasury of Lesimas. Without chaos resistance, you'd be instantly obliterated, no matter how allies you bring with you.
en_grezzo: "I've heard that Zeome's previous guardian was about level 55, so my guess is that Zeome is also around that level. There's also been reports of him wielding a scythe that allows him to fly and amplifies his magic in the treasury of Lesimas. Without chaos resistance, you'd be instantly obliterated, no matter how allies you bring with you."
it: Il guardiano che c'era prima di Zeome pare fosse di livello 55, quindi Zeome oggi starà lì intorno. E c'è anche un rapporto che dice che nella camera del tesoro di Lesimas ha preso una falce che fa volare e amplifica la magia. Senza resistenza al caos, per quanta gente ti porti dietro, in un attimo siete spazzati via.

jp: 壁生成の魔法や杖で周囲を囲んでしまえば、モンスターは召喚しづらくなる。だけど悠長に囲むにしたってその間攻撃を耐えなきゃいけない。
jp_grezzo: "壁生成の魔法や杖で周囲を囲んでしまえば、モンスターは召喚しづらくなる。だけど悠長に囲むにしたってその間攻撃を耐えなきゃいけない" + _nda(3) + "。"
en: If you can surround yourself by using spells or rods of Wall Creation, it will be difficult for him summon monsters. But even if you take the time to put up some walls, you'll have to steel yourself against his attacks the entire time.
en_grezzo: "If you can surround yourself by using spells or rods of Wall Creation, it will be difficult for him summon monsters. But even if you take the time to put up some walls, you'll have to steel yourself against his attacks the entire time."
it: Se ti chiudi intorno un muro con la magia o con la bacchetta di creazione di muri, evocare mostri gli diventa difficile. Però anche a chiudersi con calma, intanto gli attacchi bisogna reggerli.

jp: 一応、当時のゼームは相手に真っ向から近付いて接近戦を挑む傾向があったらしい。もしそのままなら、うまく誘導したり加速して振り切ったりできるかもしれない。
jp_grezzo: "一応、当時のゼームは相手に真っ向から近付いて接近戦を挑む傾向があったらしい。もしそのままなら、うまく誘導したり加速して振り切ったりできるかもしれない。"
en: In case it helps, it seems that back in the day, Zeome tended to approach his opponents head-on and challenge them to hand-to-hand combat. If his strategy since then has not changed, you might be able to lead him to a place where you have the upper hand, or outdistance him by casting Speed on yourself.
en_grezzo: "In case it helps, it seems that back in the day, Zeome tended to approach his opponents head-on and challenge them to hand-to-hand combat. If his strategy since then has not changed, you might be able to lead him to a place where you have the upper hand, or outdistance him by casting Speed on yourself."
it: Se può servire: Zeome di allora tendeva ad avvicinarsi in linea retta e a cercare il corpo a corpo. Se è rimasto così, forse lo puoi guidare dove vuoi tu, o seminarlo accelerando.

jp: 回復魔法の突破も問題。MPが切れるように仕向けるなら、MPを減らす武器や技能を用意して持久戦に持ち込む。
jp_grezzo: "回復魔法の突破も問題" + _ka(3) + "。MPが切れるように仕向けるなら、MPを減らす武器や技能を用意して持久戦に持ち込む。"
en: Then there's the problem of his recovery magic. If you're planning to exhaust his reserves of MP, get ahold of some weapons and skills that reduce MP and go in prepared for a battle of attrition.
en_grezzo: "Then there's the problem of his recovery magic. If you're planning to exhaust his reserves of MP, get ahold of some weapons and skills that reduce MP and go in prepared for a battle of attrition."
it: C'è anche il problema di superare la sua magia di cura. Se vuoi fargli finire gli MP, procurati armi e abilità che li consumano e mettiti in guerra di logoramento.

jp: 回復量を上回るダメージを与えるなら、パワーゲージを100％以上にして技能の【力の解放】や【合体攻撃発動】で仲間と一斉に叩き込むのが堅実。仲間は突撃態勢以外だとパワーゲージを温存するからタイミングを調整して。
jp_grezzo: "回復量を上回るダメージを与えるなら、パワーゲージを100％以上にして技能の【力の解放】や【合体攻撃発動】で仲間と一斉に叩き込むのが堅実" + _daro(3) + "。仲間は突撃態勢以外だとパワーゲージを温存するからタイミングを調整して。"
en: If you want to deal damage faster than he can recover it all, it's a good idea to get your power gauge to 100% or higher and use your <Gauge Release> or <Unison Impact> skills to beat on him with your allies all at once. Your allies will conserve their power gauge if they aren't obeying the Onslaught directive, so take advantage of that and time your big attacks accordingly.
en_grezzo: "If you want to deal damage faster than he can recover it all, it's a good idea to get your power gauge to 100% or higher and use your <Gauge Release> or <Unison Impact> skills to beat on him with your allies all at once. Your allies will conserve their power gauge if they aren't obeying the Onslaught directive, so take advantage of that and time your big attacks accordingly."
it: Se invece vuoi fare più danno di quanto lui ne recuperi, la via solida è portare la barra di potenza oltre il 100% e scaricargliela addosso tutti insieme coi compagni, con <Forza liberata> o con <Attacco combinato>. I compagni fuori dall'ordine di Assalto tengono da parte la barra, quindi regola i tempi.

jp: 腐ったトマトや納豆、ヨーグルトをぶつけたりして激怒させればダメージが倍になるけど、受けるダメージも倍になるから、自軍の耐久力と相談。あとは…沈黙の霧の魔法を無理矢理通すか、。充分な魔法LVがないと望みはない。
jp_grezzo: "腐ったトマトや納豆、ヨーグルトをぶつけたりして激怒させればダメージが倍になるけど、受けるダメージも倍になるから、自軍の耐久力と相談" + _dana(3) + "。あとは…沈黙の霧の魔法を無理矢理通すか、" + _dana(3) + "。充分な魔法LVがないと望みはない" + _yo(3) + "。"
en: If you enrage your friends by hurling rotten tomatoes, fermented soybeans, or yogurt at them, they'll deal twice as much damage, but they'll also receive twice as much damage, so you'll have to discuss the optimal strategy with your squad. One more option is to cast Mist of Silence to prevent Zeome from casting magic at all. If you're betting on that strategy, then you'd better have a high enough magic level, or there's no hope for you.
en_grezzo: "If you enrage your friends by hurling rotten tomatoes, fermented soybeans, or yogurt at them, they'll deal twice as much damage, but they'll also receive twice as much damage, so you'll have to discuss the optimal strategy with your squad. One more option is to cast Mist of Silence to prevent Zeome from casting magic at all. If you're betting on that strategy, then you'd better have a high enough magic level, or there's no hope for you."
it: Se li fai infuriare tirandogli addosso pomodori marci, natto o yogurt, il danno raddoppia; ma raddoppia anche quello che prendono, quindi va visto quanto regge la tua squadra. Poi... o gli fai passare per forza la magia Nebbia di silenzio. Senza un livello di magia sufficiente non c'è speranza.

jp: もし上手くいって《常闇の眼》を手に入れたら、にもちょっと情報を分けて。。
jp_grezzo: "もし上手くいって《常闇の眼》を手に入れたら、" + _ore(3) + "にもちょっと情報を分けて" + _kure(3) + "。" + _yoro(3) + "。"
en: If you actually pull this off and manage to get your hands on the <Origin of Vice>, I'd be thrilled if you gave me some information about it. Good luck.
en_grezzo: "If you actually pull this off and manage to get your hands on the <Origin of Vice>, I'd be thrilled if you gave me some information about it. Good luck."
it: Se ti va bene e metti le mani sull'<occhio delle tenebre eterne>, dividi un po' di informazioni anche con me. In bocca al lupo.

jp: 遺跡内でレベル110くらいの馬と青年に絡まれたって情報があった。どうやらイレギュラーって奴と間違えられて襲われたらしい。
jp_grezzo: "遺跡内でレベル110くらいの馬と青年に絡まれたって情報があった" + _na(3) + "。どうやらイレギュラーって奴と間違えられて襲われたらしい。"
en: I've received a report that someone got into a scuffle with young man and a horse around level 110 somewhere in the ruins. Apparently, the pair mistook him for someone named \"Irregular\" and attacked.
en_grezzo: "I've received a report that someone got into a scuffle with young man and a horse around level 110 somewhere in the ruins. Apparently, the pair mistook him for someone named \"Irregular\" and attacked."
it: Mi è arrivata voce che dentro le rovine un cavallo e un giovane sul livello 110 hanno aggredito qualcuno. Pare sia stato uno scambio di persona: cercavano un tale che chiamano l'Irregolare.

jp: そいつらも、そいつらが探している相手も名前は不明。も襲われるかもしれないから気をつけたほうがいい。
jp_grezzo: "そいつらも、そいつらが探している相手も名前は不明" + _da(3) + "。" + _kimi(3) + "も襲われるかもしれないから気をつけたほうがいい" + _yo(3) + "。"
en: Both of their names as well as the name of the person they're after are unknown. You'd better be careful, because you might their next target.
en_grezzo: "Both of their names as well as the name of the person they're after are unknown. You'd better be careful, because you might their next target."
it: Di quei due, e di chi stanno cercando, non si sa il nome. Potrebbe toccare anche a te, quindi sta' in guardia.

jp: 見える範囲にいると青年は精霊を召喚することがあるそう。煙幕を張ったり壁生成で視線を切ったりテレポートの杖で吹っ飛ばしたりするといいかもしれない。
jp_grezzo: "見える範囲にいると青年は精霊を召喚することがあるそう" + _da(3) + "。煙幕を張ったり壁生成で視線を切ったりテレポートの杖で吹っ飛ばしたりするといいかもしれない" + _na(3) + "。"
en: I've heard that the young man may summon spirits when he's within sight. You might want to put up a smoke screen, use Wall Creation to cut off their line of sight, or send them away with rods of teleportation.
en_grezzo: "I've heard that the young man may summon spirits when he's within sight. You might want to put up a smoke screen, use Wall Creation to cut off their line of sight, or send them away with rods of teleportation."
it: Pare che il giovane, se ti ha a tiro, evochi degli spiriti. Può servire una cortina di fumo, oppure tagliare la linea di vista con la creazione di muri, o spazzarli via con una bacchetta di teletrasporto.

jp: 精霊どもはMPを減らす眼差しを向けてくるらしいから…やはり相手からなるべく見えないようにすると集中攻撃を防げる。
jp_grezzo: "精霊どもはMPを減らす眼差しを向けてくるらしいから…やはり相手からなるべく見えないようにすると集中攻撃を防げる" + _na(3) + "。"
en: I've heard that the spirits he summons will gaze at you to reduce your MP... so from the opponent's point of view, trying to avoid their gaze means that you won't be able to concentrate your attacks.
en_grezzo: "I've heard that the spirits he summons will gaze at you to reduce your MP... so from the opponent's point of view, trying to avoid their gaze means that you won't be able to concentrate your attacks."
it: Gli spiriti lanciano uno sguardo che consuma MP... quindi, di nuovo: stare il meno possibile nel loro campo visivo evita di prendersi tutti i colpi insieme.

jp: MPがどんどん減る魔漏状態にされると厳しいから、MPを回復できる魔力の巻物か杖を多めに用意しておくといい。
jp_grezzo: "MPがどんどん減る魔漏状態にされると厳しいから、MPを回復できる魔力の巻物か杖を多めに用意しておくといい" + _daro(3) + "。"
en: It's going to get tough being in a situation where your MP is constantly leaking away, so it's a good idea to prepare some scrolls or rods with magic that can restore MP.
en_grezzo: "It's going to get tough being in a situation where your MP is constantly leaking away, so it's a good idea to prepare some scrolls or rods with magic that can restore MP."
it: Se ti mettono nello stato in cui gli MP colano via di continuo sono guai, quindi conviene portarsi dietro parecchie pergamene o bacchette di mana per rimetterli a posto.

jp: ちなみに一番強いのは馬らしい。角に刺されると強烈な混沌の渦が発生することがあるらしい。襲われた奴はたまたま混沌耐性を高めていたから助かったものの、そうでなけりゃ余裕でお陀仏だったって話。
jp_grezzo: "ちなみに一番強いのは馬らしい" + _yo(3) + "。角に刺されると強烈な混沌の渦が発生することがあるらしい" + _na(3) + "。襲われた奴はたまたま混沌耐性を高めていたから助かったものの、そうでなけりゃ余裕でお陀仏だったって話" + _da(3) + "。"
en: By the way, the stronger one out of the two is apparently the horse. I heard that getting stabbed by its horn causes Chaos Ball to break out. The guy who was attacked just so happened to have a high level of resistance to chaos, so he managed to survive, but if he wasn't so lucky he would have perished in the end.
